Supported authored legacy twins retain canonical ownership; genuine adjacent raw operands retain full authored text/offsets. Counts add uncovered expression occurrences to existing fallback counts, while display text is unique. Final current primary/census captures are fresh; earlier captures/producers are frozen. Failed file-route, mixed-version initial compatibility capture and unmasked diagnostic replay are excluded from current acceptance.
